description: USE WHEN the question is about the AI economy: where its four capitals — Material, Intelligence, Network, Diversity — are moving, and how concentrated that movement is. Returns counts, directional pulse, a sparkline, a diversity/conscience index and top signals for each of the four capitals (M=Material, I=Intelligence, N=Network, D=Diversity) over a trailing window. NEXT: call get_trends_signal for feed shape and the crypto-distribution lens, or get_batch_signals to pull all three signals in one round-trip. This measures published attention and announced capital — not settled transactions.

days.description: Trailing window length in days (1–120). Default 30.

disease.description: Narrow the capital breakdown to signals matching this keyword.

name: get_mind_signal
